I don't normally review newly purchased items but I'll comment on what I can. 
1. I put this together and it was very easy. A 1-person job until putting the lid on. My daughter helped with that.
2. It lights with one push of the button. Every time.
3. It heats evenly and I haven't had any flareups yet.

The real test will be in a year or two. If it develops rust like every low-end grill I've owned, I'll be pretty upset.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber and I wouldn't buy anything else -- my first one lasted 20 years and was still usable! The size is just right for my deck and, more importantly, the heat is very even and controllable. And there are small but important changes since my last Weber. The grilling space is larger, the overall area is greater (the height of the cover has increased), and the small rack is higher which makes it easy to access the rear of the grill. I love it.
Results.Title: Weber is the only brand I would buy.

Results.ReviewText: I have always heard about how great the grills are but I thought could they really make the food taste that much better to be worth the price. Yup. I consider myself a pretty good cook with a grasp of the essentials. Tools are only as good as the person using them. As long as a person knows what they are doing they can really get this grill to produce some spectacular meals. It took basic burgers and steaks to the next level. I used to use sous vide and a cast iron pan because my last grill produced inconsistent results. It also caramelizes veggies really well. The temperature control is phenomenal. I seasoned it well and everything slides around the grates like it’s on ice. They produce great seat marks.  I also noticed they thought of the little things like a match holder if it doesn’t light. Little things like that show the attention to detail.
Results.Title: Better than expected

Results.ReviewText:
This grill is absolutely wonderful. The cast iron grill surface gets really hot and creates a great sear on anything that touches it. The grill itself has no problem reaching 550-600 degrees every time but still seems to burn propane efficiently. I have found myself meal planning based on what I can cook on the grill. 
My previous grill (not a Weber) was completely rusted out and had hot spots and cold spots on the grilling surface. I ruined and undercooked so much chicken and a few steaks. Heartbreaking. This grill cooks and heats so evenly! No more well done steaks or medium rare chicken. 
I purchased the igrill 3 to go along with the Spirit 2 E310 and I absolutely love it. It really does take the guessing out of grilling! I use it every time I use the grill. The results have been fantastic! Everything has been perfectly cooked. It mounts nicely to the grill in like 5 minutes.
Results.Title: Absolutely Fantastic

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
